page.title: The midnight bakery
page.description: The last train has gone. One shop is still glowing. A little adventure where you decide what happens next.

scenes.heading: A light in the rain
scenes.text:
You duck under a striped awning. Behind the bakery window, a tiny fox in an apron is frosting a cake twice its size. It spots you and points at the door.

A sign reads: ONE FAVOUR. ONE WISH.

choices.label: Go inside and help the fox
Read the smaller writing on the sign

scenes.heading: A very important delivery
scenes.text:
The fox hands you a silver cake box. ‘The moon forgot her birthday,’ it whispers. ‘Would you take this up?’

A ladder leans against the back wall. Its top disappears into the clouds.

choices.label: Climb the ladder with the cake
Ask for a slice before agreeing

scenes.heading: The small print
scenes.text:
You wipe rain from the sign. Under the big letters: WISHES CANNOT BE FOR YOURSELF.

Inside, the fox has fallen asleep beside a photograph of a forest. It looks very far from home.

choices.label: Wish the fox a way home
Wake the fox and offer to help

scenes.heading: A birthday above the clouds
scenes.text:
The moon takes one careful bite. Every puddle in the city glows gold.

‘Make a wish,’ she says. You wish that nobody has to spend their birthday alone. Somewhere below, a thousand phones begin to ring.

scenes.heading: A fair exchange
scenes.text:
The fox grins. You share a slice at a flour-dusted table. The rain stops. For the first time all week, neither of you is in a hurry.

‘That was the wish,’ the fox says. ‘Someone to have cake with.’

scenes.heading: The door in the oven
scenes.text:
The oven clicks open. A breeze carries the scent of pine. The fox wakes, sees the forest, and presses a cinnamon bun into your hand.

By morning the bakery is gone. On rainy nights, you still smell cinnamon at that corner.

props.label: A small hint?
props.text: Not every wish has to be yours. There are three endings to find.

reply: This is a ready-made example of a playable story. You choose what happens next. There are three endings; use Start over to find another one.
